handoff_permission_contract.platform: Linux only, actual SO_PEERCRED both directions
handoff_permission_contract.pair_directory: 0710 receiver UID and exact per-pair GID, mounted only pair endpoints; sender group has search but no directory write
handoff_permission_contract.socket: 0660 receiver UID and exact pair GID; no world permissions
handoff_permission_contract.pair_groups: two nonzero distinct controlled GIDs; planner first group, selector both, executor second; no private-key/DB-secret files share these groups
handoff_permission_contract.initialization: explicit trusted short-lived privileged init sets validated UID/GID/modes/mounts, then drops/removes privilege; runtime roles distinct non-root
handoff_permission_contract.peer_checks: exact expected peer UID, run/task/client/sender/target, strict bounded envelope, reciprocal peer verification; unauthorized role/wrong UID connect denied
handoff_permission_contract.compatibility: reconciles draft0600 socket with distinct UID; no existing protocol/core API change, first package review must verify
